rules.comment: Allow natural pillagers at Overworld surface height. Vanilla only adds pillagers to the NATURAL spawn pool around pillager outposts, so this restores outpost populations without allowing other surface monsters.
Drowned generated by ocean ruins use the STRUCTURE reason and remain allowed. Deny only ordinary NATURAL drowned spawning at every height; zombie conversion, commands and spawn eggs remain available.
Natural hostile mobs only below Y=0 in the Overworld. Y=0 and above is denied; spawners and other spawn reasons remain allowed.
